name.title: Form name
name.description: Unique identifier for the use in the parser function {{#jsonforms: <form name> }} to print this form in any wiki page

action.description: "none" should only be used when the submitted data is handled by a callback declared in [[MediaWiki:DefaultEditorOptions]]

pagename_formula.title: Page name formula
pagename_formula.description: can contain wikitext, properties values are retrieved using an expression like <parent.child> (e.g. <name> or <address.country>)

create_only_fields.title: Create-only fields
create_only_fields.description: Add properties (usually used in the pagename formula) that must be shown only on data creation

overwrite_existing_article_on_create.title: Overwrite existing article
overwrite_existing_article_on_create.description: If enabled, existing articles with the same name will be overwritten

slot.title: target slot
slot.description: Default slot for form data: if different from main the related article will be saved as a [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Multi-Content_Revisions Multi-Content-Revision]

edit_categories.title: Edit categories
edit_categories.description: Is the user allowed to edit categories before submitting the form ?

default_categories.title: Default categories
default_categories.description: only if Edit categories is enabled

preload_wikitext.title: Preload wikitext
preload_wikitext.description: Preload wikitext into the target article. (Performs substitutions using an expression like <parent.child>).

return.title: Return
return.description: Page to redirect to after completion

return_page.title: Return page
return_page.description: Page to redirect to after completion

return_url.title: Return URL
return_url.description: External URL to redirect to after completion. (Performs substitutions using an expression like <parent.child>)

edit_path.title: Edit path
edit_path.description: Target path for form data (dot separated – array items can be added with <path>.[])

show_infobox.title: Show Infobox
show_infobox.description: Whether to show an infobox on the target page

infobox_template.title: Infobox template
infobox_template.description: Template to use (leave empty for automatic generation)

display_path.title: Display path
display_path.description: Json path to the subschema used to display a partial form (dot separated)

title.title: Form title
title.description: If different from the form name

css_class.title: CSS class
css_class.description: CSS class applied to the rendered view

base_options.title: base options
base_options.description: Editor options in the MediaWiki: namespace, javascript content model

base_script.title: base script
base_script.description: Editor options in the MediaWiki: namespace, javascript content model

max_depth.title: max depth
max_depth.description: Maximum nesting depth for the editor

default_additional_properties.title: default additional properties
default_additional_properties.description: Default value for additionalProperties in schemas

use_lazy_properties.title: use lazy properties
use_lazy_properties.description: When to use lazy loading for properties

lazy_properties_threshold.title: lazy properties threshold
lazy_properties_threshold.description: Number of properties at which to enable lazy loading (only used when use_lazy_properties is 'threshold')

remove_empty_properties.title: remove empty properties
remove_empty_properties.description: Remove empty properties from the data

remove_false_properties.title: remove false properties
remove_false_properties.description: Remove false properties from the data
